component.name: Earshot
component.summary: Music from YouTube, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, Mixcloud and the Internet Archive

description.p: Earshot is a music player for all of YouTube's music, plus Bandcamp, SoundCloud, Mixcloud and the Internet Archive, in one library. Search them all at once, play full albums and soundtracks, and let Earshot find more music like what you play. Free, with no account.

ul.li: YouTube's songs, music videos, playlists and full albums, with music first in search results
Full-length album and soundtrack videos split into their songs
Bandcamp by genre or any tag, SoundCloud, Mixcloud's DJ mixes and the Internet Archive's live concerts
Discover Weekly, Daily Mixes and Release Radar from what you play, kept on your computer
Random radio that keeps playing songs like the last ones when the queue ends
Charts by genre and era, and radio stations made of songs shared on Reddit
Playlists, liked songs and saved albums; a mini player, tray icon and now-playing card
A web version for phones that shares your library

screenshot.caption: Search YouTube, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, Mixcloud and the Internet Archive at once
Made for you: Discover Weekly and Daily Mixes

ul.li: History in the sidebar: the songs you've listened to, newest first, with when you played them.

For You mixes draw from every source (Deezer, Bandcamp, Mixcloud, SoundCloud, the Internet Archive and Reddit), branch out to new artists, and no one artist or game takes over a mix; Daily Mixes have at least 20 songs.
Earshot carries on where it left off: the queue, song and position come back paused on the next launch or visit.
"Level the volume between songs" in Settings evens out loud and quiet songs.
Encrypted SoundCloud songs play with Widevine in the app, or from YouTube when they can't.
A click anywhere on a song plays or pauses it; the source badge opens the song's own page.
Reddit videos play their own sound from Reddit, and songs that won't play anywhere are left out of mixes.
A bigger waveform beside the song in the player bar, and clicking the song opens the mix it's playing from.
Sharper text in the app at fractional scaling.
The web version plays YouTube, SoundCloud and Mixcloud on iPhones and iPads, and YouTube songs start in about a second.
When a SoundCloud song won't play, the same song plays from YouTube.
Seeking and song lengths are right on iPhones, and a pause stays paused.
A bigger waveform beside the title on the phone's Now playing page.
Only "Couldn't play" when nothing will play a song; no other notices.
Click a cover to see it large.
The cover in the player bar fills its corner.
Browsing Bandcamp by genre works again.
Every search puts YouTube Music's songs, official videos, albums and playlists first; YouTube's other videos follow.
Notifications are off by default; notices show inside the window, with settings to turn them back on.
Only one Earshot runs at a time across the Flatpak, AppImage and other builds.
YouTube searches put songs, music videos and albums first, and add YouTube Music's when YouTube's own results have little music in them.
A "Prefer music in YouTube results" setting.
The waveform hides while nothing plays.
Recent searches close when you click elsewhere.
